subject: Sponsor intro & CTO attendance for product briefing
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karin Schultz <karin.schultz@helixworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor intro & CTO attendance for product briefing

Hi Karin —

Thanks again for the time on our discovery call. We'd like to lock in a 90–120 minute product briefing that includes a short executive intro (VP/Head sponsor) and a CTO presence for a 20–30 minute technical Q&A. From our side Marissa will run the demo and Grace will cover architecture and integrations.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Jun 23, 10:00–12:00
- Wed Jun 24, 13:00–15:00
- Fri Jun 26, 09:00–11:00

If none of those work, send 3 slots that work for your CTO and sponsor and we'll triage. I've attached a short agenda and the signed NDA per your request.

Quick ask: can your team confirm whether the CTO needs an explicit stakeholder-level slide or if they'd prefer to jump into the deep-dive? We can prepare either.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (pdf, 1 page), HelixWorks-NDA-signed.pdf (pdf, 2 pages)

From: Karin Schultz <karin.schultz@helixworks.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixworks.com, Alan Wu <alan.wu@helixworks.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 13:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor intro & CTO attendance for product briefing

Ben —

Thanks for the agenda and NDA. We've reviewed and signed the NDA (attached). The CTO (Alan) can join but his calendar is tight next week. Alan is flexible afternoon Eastern time most days; the sponsor (Karin) is available in the mornings. To make this work we may need to shorten the exec intro to 15 minutes and then have Alan join for the second half-hour.

Our preferred windows (ET):
- Tue Jun 23, 15:00–16:30 ET
- Wed Jun 24, 14:30–16:30 ET (Alan can join 15:00–15:40)
- Thu Jun 25, 11:00–13:00 ET (less ideal for Alan)

Can you confirm whether a staggered attendance (exec intro first, then CTO for technical Q&A) is acceptable? Also, procurement is included on this thread — they'll want a calendar hold and a brief on licensing/pricing at the end (15 minutes).

—Karin
Karin Schultz
Director, IT Strategy, HelixWorks
karin.schultz@helixworks.com

Attachment: HelixWorks-NDA-signed.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, procurement@helixworks.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor intro & CTO attendance for product briefing

On Wed, Jun 17, 2026 at 13:07 Karin Schultz <karin.schultz@helixworks.com> wrote:
> Can you confirm whether a staggered attendance (exec intro first, then CTO for technical Q&A) is acceptable? Also, procurement is included on this thread — they'll want a calendar hold and a brief on licensing/pricing at the end (15 minutes).

Karin —

Yes, staggered attendance is fine and often cleaner for tight CTO calendars. Proposed run of show (90 minutes total):
- 0–15m: Sponsor intro (Karin + Redwood VP-level slide)
- 15–55m: Product demo (Marissa)
- 55–80m: CTO technical Q&A (Grace + Alan)
- 80–90m: Licensing/pricing snapshot (Ben + procurement)

If Alan can join at ~55m into the session that should let him skip the sponsor intro. For the Tue Jun 23 option you suggested (15:00–16:30 ET), that maps to 12:00–13:30 PT which works for our team.

I'll create a calendar draft and include a short pricing appendix so procurement can review. Ben — can you confirm the price-range slide we'll include (bullet points only) and whether you want procurement to receive a separate pre-read?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

Karin / Alan / procurement team —
